no_adcom_quote.quote: Advisory Committee Meeting needed? YES, date if known __________ NO

summary: No advisory committee was convened for PYLERA (NDA 50-786, original 2006 approval). The only reference to an advisory committee anywhere in the original review documents is a filing-checklist item in the Administrative Correspondence asking whether an AC meeting was needed, and its 'date if known' field is left blank. Neither the Medical Review nor the approval letter describes any advisory committee meeting, vote, members, or recommendation, and no transcript is present in paperclip.
